outline: 本課程旨在幫助學生熟稔運用基本重要文法以寫出正確自然, 表達清晰之句子.  內容包括語法結構和錯誤分析, 例如不完整句、誤置修飾語、不連結修飾語、散漫句、錯誤平行結構、易混淆字、贅詞等常見問題。
schedule:
1.  Topic sentences
2.  Paragraph outlines
3.  prewriting, writing, revising and editing paragraphs
4.  narration
5.  (cont.)
6.  description
7.  (cont.)
8.  peer discussion
9.  mid-term exam
10.  cause and effect
11. (cont.)
12.  analysis by division
13.  (cont.)
14.  wordiness, reducdancy, vagueness: diction
15.  comparision and contrast
16.  (cont.)
17.  definition: claryfying terms
18.  final exam
assessment:
1.  writing papers  60%
2.  full attendance 5%
3.  class participation 25%
4.  quizzes and tests 10%
